info.title: AegisOps SaaS & Local Inspection API Contract
info.description: Shared API contract between Tier 1 Local Collector (Sherwin), Tier 2 SaaS Backend (Praveen), and Operations Dashboard (Darain). SaaS endpoints run on :8000 (/api/v1/*). Local-only Collector Egress Proof endpoints run exclusively on 127.0.0.1:8001 and are NEVER called by SaaS.

servers.description: Tier 1 Local Collector Inspection API (Local-Only — NEVER exposed to SaaS)

CollectorTokenAuth.name: X-Collector-Token
CollectorTokenAuth.description: Collector-specific credential bound server-side to (tenant_id, collector_id).

post.summary: Ingest single or batch allow-listed metadata payload from Tier 1 collector
post.description: Strictly validates payload against contracts/metadata.schema.json (additionalProperties=false), enforces server-bound tenant_id, verifies idempotency on (tenant_id, payload_id), persists to PostgreSQL, and triggers health/anomaly/correlation pipeline.

200.description: Duplicate payload_id acknowledged idempotently without duplicating storage

403.description: Declared tenant_id or collector_id does not match authenticated credential

422.description: Strict schema validation failure (e.g., unknown/unapproved field rejected)

post.summary: Receive periodic collector heartbeat and outbox depth

get.summary: Fleet overview summary for authenticated tenant

200.description: Fleet health, collector counts, active incidents, health distribution, last update UTC

get.summary: Time-series approved metrics ordered strictly by event_time_utc
List collectors, 4-state health, staleness, heartbeat age, and outbox queue counts for tenant
List correlated incidents with contributing signals and explainable recommendations
Detailed incident timeline, correlation explanation, and recommendations

404.description: Incident not found in caller tenant

post.summary: Execute policy-checked, human-approved SIMULATED remediation with audit log and rollback plan

200.description: Simulated remediation audit record and rollback plan

get.summary: List SaaS-side received metadata records and payload SHA-256 hashes for Egress Proof verification

200.description: Approved metadata records received by SaaS (never contains raw data)

get.summary: Measured delivery reliability, duplicate rejections, out-of-order counts, and observed latencies

200.description: Measured reliability telemetry (unmeasured fields explicitly null / Not measured)

get.summary: Active policy version, allow-listed schema fields, regional routing config, and tenant isolation posture
[LOCAL COLLECTOR :8001 ONLY] Inspect raw local events alongside exact serialized outbound JSON & SHA-256 hash
get.description: Served only by Tier 1 collector on 127.0.0.1:8001. NEVER accessible from Tier 2 SaaS.

200.description: List of local egress proof records conforming to contracts/egress_proof.schema.json

get.summary: [LOCAL COLLECTOR :8001 ONLY] Inspect local SQLite transactional outbox state, buffered count, retries, and connection status
